To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ageing of Li-ion batteries is a very complex phenomenon and it can only be understood and modelled by taking into consideration the effect of multiple factors.
the battery ageing estimation is a complex process and requires a multidisciplinary approach.
the battery ageing is the most important factor for the battery health monitoring and the estimation of the remaining useful life (RUL) of Li-ion battery in EVs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the state-of-the-art in battery ageing modelling, health monitoring and SoH estimation for Li-ion batteries.

the following aspects of Li-ion battery: (1) ageing mechanisms, (2) ageing models, (3) SoH and EoL estimation, (4) battery management system, (5) battery pack design, (6) battery recycling, and (7) safety.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current state of the art is not yet sufficient to accurately estimate battery ageing and predict its EoL. The paper also presents the future scope of
the research community has been able to develop and demonstrate various models and algorithms that can estimate ageing and SoH of Li-ion battery in real time.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

there are several techniques for Li-ion battery ageing and state of health (or SoH) estimation, but none of them are perfect and can be used for all types of battery systems, as each technique has its own advantages and drawbacks.
the most promising technique in battery health monitoring and ageing estimation is the combination of electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) and neural network based algorithms.
there are various techniques and models that are used to estimate the state of charge (SoC), state of health ( SoH ) and end of life of a Li-ion battery.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a lack of consensus on a single model or algorithm to be used for Li-ion battery health monitoring and ageing estimation.
there are many techniques for battery ageing estimation, but none of them are fully reliable.
, the battery health monitoring and ageing estimation are still in its infancy and needs more research in order to be implemented in real time systems.
